name: Cal's Costume Conundrum!!
source:
Which costume is the best? Cal needs to know! Infiltrate her siblings’ Halloween party, interview the guests, and crown a winner!

Cal Montgomery has been assigned a homework assignment of the highest importance: writing about her favorite Halloween costume! Conveniently, her siblings are hosting a Halloween party downstairs. All she needs to do is head down there, interview all the guests, and decide which is her favorite!

[From [url=https://amarvelous.itch.io/cals-costume-conundrum]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哪种服装最好？卡尔需要知道！潜入她兄弟姐妹的万圣节派对，采访嘉宾，并加冕获胜者！

卡尔蒙哥马利被分配了一项最重要的家庭作业：写她最喜欢的万圣节服装！正好，她的兄弟姐妹正在楼下举办万圣节派对。她所需要做的就是前往那里，采访所有客人，然后决定哪一个是她最喜欢的！

[来自[url=https://amarvelous.itch.io/cals-costume-conundrum]Itch.io[/url]]
